title: Tech Note: Integrating the Google Feed API with 4DAF

historical_commentary.text: Both halves of this integration are now defunct: Google shut down its AJAX APIs (including the Feed API) years ago, and the 4D Ajax Framework it's wired into has also been discontinued, making this note a snapshot of a specific, now-unreachable mashup pattern from the late-2000s AJAX/'Web 2.0' era rather than a usable how-to.
related_updates: Google deprecated and shut down its AJAX Feed API years ago; the integration described is no longer functional as written
4D Ajax Framework (4DAF) has also been fully discontinued
